SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-01: CQL — Types - Primitive. Test these items: Any type, Boolean type, Integer type, Decimal type, String type, Long type (CQL 1.5 trial-use).

This is the EXPLORER pass for CQL-01 and must run after SKEPTIC and HISTORIAN fixes currently present in the codebase. Start from scratch for this personality and do not inspect or rely on any archived workflow outputs under fhir4ds-private/docs/prompts/.ai_loop/spec_comp/**. Use active prompts/state, source code, official/local conformance fixtures, and fresh tests/probes only.

Explorer lens: search for non-obvious primitive-type gaps in public execution surfaces, nullable/dynamic SQL shapes, parser boundary behavior, macro/UDF registration, and interactions between CQL primitive translation and FHIRPath-derived primitive values. Re-test SKEPTIC/HISTORIAN-touched areas independently rather than trusting prior personality outputs.

For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For CQL primitive types, cover translator behavior, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, direct Python APIs, public DuckDB UDF/macro surfaces, edge coercions, invalid type behavior, and official conformance cases relevant to the chunk. Verify there are no regressions in conformance tests or unit/e2e pytest coverage relevant to this chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write qa_handoff.md, engineer_handoff.md, architect_handoff.md, update GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE.md/ARCHIVE_LOG.md/AGENTS.md as appropriate, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.title: Direct FHIR choice primitive is/as used SQL text shape instead of runtime FHIR type
issues.description: Fresh native-loaded and forced Python fallback probes showed direct FHIR choice values such as valueString '5' satisfying `as Integer`, valueInteger satisfying `as String`, and valueInteger failing `is Integer` because translation classified the fhirpath_text value by SQL text shape.
issues.resolution: Primitive `is`/`as` translation now detects direct FHIRPath UDF value calls and asks FHIRPath for `type().name`; assertions use that runtime primitive type before applying typed SQL casts.
issues.validation: Added native/fallback primitive parity coverage for valueInteger, valueString, valueBoolean, and valueDecimal.

issues.title: Primitive conversion lowering and DuckDB macros used generic casts or raised on invalid inputs
issues.description: `ToInteger()` and `convert ... to Integer` lowered through DuckDB casts that rounded decimal-looking strings/decimals. Direct DuckDB `ToDecimal` and `ToBoolean` macros also diverged from spec/null semantics between invalid values and conversion-check functions.
issues.resolution: `ToInteger`, `ToDecimal`, `ToBoolean`, and `convert ... to <primitive>` now route through spec-aware conversion macros/UDFs. `ToDecimal` rejects booleans, `ToBoolean` handles only valid boolean domains, and invalid inputs return NULL/false without throwing.
issues.validation: Native-loaded and forced Python fallback conversion probes matched, and conversion parity/unit coverage was updated.

issues.title: Malformed no-whitespace numeric suffixes were accepted
issues.description: The CQL lexer/parser accepted malformed numeric forms such as `1LL`, `1.0L`, and `1day` instead of rejecting the invalid no-whitespace suffix.
issues.resolution: The numeric lexer now raises on alphanumeric or underscore suffix characters immediately following an Integer/Decimal literal after the optional Long suffix.
issues.validation: Primitive parser coverage now asserts these malformed literals raise while valid CQL numeric forms continue to parse.

issues.title: Materialized primitive query definitions lost primitive type metadata
issues.description: Primitive values returned through query CTEs were materialized as SQL strings, causing later `V is String` checks to pass and `V is Decimal` checks to fail for definitions such as `First([Observation] O return O.valueQuantity.value)`.
issues.resolution: Type inference now derives primitive CQL types for simple FHIR retrieve property returns from schema metadata. Primitive `is`/`as` translation uses `definition_meta.cql_type` for materialized identifiers before falling back to SQL shape checks.
issues.validation: Added native-loaded and forced Python fallback execution coverage proving materialized Decimal definitions retain Decimal assertion behavior.
